references.text: Micah had made an ephod and household gods (teraphim), which the priest now takes with him.
The same Levite who was hired as a priest by Micah now leaves him to follow the Danites.
The Danites mention the sacred objects (ephod, teraphim, and carved image) that are now taken by the priest.
The Danites took the sacred objects from Micah's house, and the priest protested at first before being persuaded.
Teraphim (household gods) are mentioned here when Rachel stole her father's household gods, a parallel to the theft of religious items.
The ephod was part of the priest's holy garments used to seek the Lord's will.
Hosea prophesies that Israel will be without an ephod or teraphim - the same objects mentioned here.
